buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR BID DERS 1. Earnest Money Deposit (EMD): The bidder may submit the EMD in the form of an Account Payee Demand Draft drawn in favour of “DDO, Prasar Bharati, All India Radio”, payab le at Bhopal. The bidder shall upload a scanned copy of the Demand Draft/ proof of payment along with the bid documents and shall ensure submissio n/delivery of the original hard copy to the Buyer within five (5) days fro m the Bid End Date/Bid Opening Date, as applicable. 2. Payment of Salaries and Wages: The Service Provider shall, at its own cost and responsibility, make payme nt of salaries/wages to all contracted personnel deployed at the Buyer’s pr emises before raising a claim for reimbursement/payment from the Buyer. The Service Provider shall ensure timely and lawful payment of all wages a nd statutory dues to the deployed personnel. 3. Net Worth of OEM: The Net Worth of the Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), wherever ap plicable, shall be positive as per the latest audited financial statement s. 4. Duty Hours and Attendance: The normal duty hours for the Data Entry Operator (DEO)/Multi-Tasking Sta ff (MTS) shall be from 09:30 hours to 18:00 hours. Strict punctuality and regular attendance shall be essential requirements of the assignment. The deployed personnel may be required to perform duties on their weekly off days, whenever exigencies of work so require. In such cases, compensator y leave/off shall be provided on another working day, subject to the directi ons of the competent authority and applicable rules. 5. Leave and Substitute Manpower: The deployed DEO/MTS shall inform the concerned office sufficiently in adv ance regarding any intended absence or leave, except in cases of unavoid able circumstances. Where the period of absence exceeds the permissible l imit or is likely to adversely affect the functioning of the office, the Service Provider shall arrange suitable substitute manpower without any disruption to the assigned work. 6. Wages Linked to Attendance: Payment of wages to the deployed DEO/MTS shall be strictly based on their actual attendance and deployment at the designated place of work, subjec t to the terms of the contract. The Service Provider shall ensure that wages are paid to the deployed personnel within the first week of the succeedi ng month, and in any event by the 5th day of every month. 7. Nature of Duties: The deployed DEO/MTS shall perform all duties assigned by the competent /higher officer in connection with the functioning of the office. This may inc lude reasonable manual assistance and other ancillary duties as may be re quired for official work and as are commensurate with the nature of the en gagement.

8. Biometric Attendance: The Agency/Bidder shall install and maintain a suitable biometric attend ance system/machine at its own cost for recording and monitoring the at tendance of the deployed personnel, wherever required by the Buyer. 9. Local Office Requirement: The bidder/Service Provider shall have a functional office located within Bh opal. Documentary proof of the office address may be required to be sub mitted along with the bid or at any stage during the contract period. 10. Timely Payment of Wages: The bidder/Service Provider shall ensure that salaries/wages payable to all deployed personnel are credited/paid latest by the 5th day of every m onth, in accordance with applicable labour laws and statutory requirement s. 11. Submission of Monthly Bills: The bidder/Service Provider shall submit its monthly bill/invoice, along with all requisite supporting documents, attendance records and other docume nts prescribed by the Buyer, latest by the 5th day of the succeeding month. 12. Similar Work Experience: The bidder shall have a minimum of three (3) years of relevant experi ence in providing Data Entry Operators (DEOs)/Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) o r similar manpower services to Central Government offices/organizati ons. Documentary evidence in support of such experience shall be submitt ed along with the bid. 13. Income Tax Returns and Turnover: The bidder shall submit Income Tax Return (ITR) statements for the p receding three (3) financial years, along with such other financial docu ments as may be required, in support of its declared turnover and financial capacity. 14. GST Registration: The bidder shall possess a valid GSTIN registration and shall upload a co py of the applicable GST Registration Certificate along with the bid docume nts. 15. Jurisdiction: In the event of any dispute, difference, or claim arising out of or in connecti on with the tender, contract, or services provided thereunder, the courts h aving territorial jurisdiction at Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh, shall have j urisdiction, subject to the applicable laws and rules. 16. Compliance with Applicable Laws: The bidder/Service Provider shall comply with all applicable Central and St ate Government laws, rules, regulations, labour laws, statutory requiremen ts and directions issued by the competent authority from time to time in re lation to the services and personnel deployed under the contract. 17. Responsibility of the Service Provider: The Service Provider shall remain responsible for the conduct, discipline, at tendance, timely payment of wages and compliance with all applicable stat utory obligations in respect of the personnel deployed by it. Any failure in t his regard shall be dealt with in accordance with the terms and conditions of the contract. The work order, including the quantity and period of the work, shall be subject to the administrativ
e approval by the competent authority from time to time, as applicable. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
